title: Extension proof recovered from joined proof
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits. For any Boolean assignment to the circuit’s extension variables and any Boolean inner proof of length $2^m+2^{m^2}$, where $m$ is the number of quadratic variables associated with $C$, the extension extracted from the joined proof is the original extension assignment.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
A Boolean assignment to its extension variables
A Boolean inner proof of length $2^m+2^{m^2}$, with $m$ the number of circuit quadratic variables
